terminal_evidence.expected_description: Complete all Lightfall missions on Legendary difficulty.
terminal_evidence.source_reference: Bungie mobile Manifest record definition; completing every campaign mission on Legendary is sufficient evidence that the campaign was completed somewhere on the profile.

contents.rule_reason: Match the canonical public content title. The verified profile-scoped Legendary triumph proves account completion but does not identify the completing character.
